entity.description:
Aavi was a minor character who appeared in Mortal Kombat: Conquest series in the episode entitled “The Serpent And The Ice."

Aavi was a villager of Zhu Zin who lost her mind many years before the events of Conquest, after her child was kidnapped, presumably by the Lin Kuei, and her husband was killed while he attempted to protect their child.
